title: Flow Double-Click Catalogue Spotlight
description: Double-clicking empty flow canvas background opens an inline search at the cursor. Typing filters catalogue nodes; hovering a match (or the top match while typing) previews it as a highlighted ghost node on the canvas (same paint path as catalogue drag). Enter/click inserts the node at the double-click world point; Escape closes and clears the ghost.
summary: Restored flow canvas double-click catalogue spotlight in FlowGraphCanvasHost. Empty-canvas double-click opens an inline search; typing ranks catalogue matches and previews the active row as a highlighted ghost node via setGhostWidget; hover/arrow keys switch the preview; Enter/click places the node at the double-click world point. Added flowRankCatalogueSuggestions / flowCatalogueItemDescriptor helpers and vitest coverage.
